FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Secure Storage Solutions, we operate a state-of-the-art self-storage facility designed to meet the diverse needs of our customers while maintaining strict compliance with all regulations. Our facility is a single-story design, ensuring safety and reducing any potential fire hazards. We provide 24/7 surveillance and controlled access systems to ensure the security of all stored items. Our team follows rigorous documentation protocols, particularly for portable storage units that are allowed on-site for up to 90 days, with adherence to all fire safety guidelines. Importantly, we do not allow the storage of flammable, explosive, or toxic substances, thereby significantly minimizing risks related to fire and environmental contamination. In addition to storage, we offer packing supplies to facilitate our clients' needs and ensure their items are well-protected during storage. Our commitment to safety, security, and excellent customer service makes us a trusted choice in the area.

Our self-storage facility provides space for individuals and businesses to store a variety of items, including flammable liquids and chemicals, as they often require secure and accessible locations for their operations.
